::: {.callout-note}
## Design Philosophy
"High-Trust, Zero-Clutter Fintech". The interface marries Silicon Valley minimalism (Wealthfront) with Shenzhen digital banking precision (WeBank / Futu) and conversational warmth (Ant Group's Zhixiaobao).
:::

# Competitive Benchmark: Deconstruction of the Leaders

To engineer an award-winning interface for the WeBank & Shenzhen University jury, we audited the three premier wealthtech platforms across the US and Chinese markets:

| Dimension | Wealthfront (US) 🇺🇸 | Zhixiaobao / Ant Fortune 🇨🇳 | Futu / Moomoo (Shenzhen) 🇭🇰 | **WeAdvisory AI (Our System)** |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Primary Interaction** | Static multi-step questionnaire | Natural language chat | Dense quote charts & order book | **Synchronized Split-Screen (Chat + Real-time Cockpit)** |
| **Visual Style** | Minimalist light / slate | Mobile consumer UI | High-density dark mode | **Clean Slate Dark Glassmorphism** |
| **Quant Visualization** | 30-year Monte Carlo cone | Basic fund performance cards | Technical analysis candlestick charts | **Interactive Risk Cone + Dynamic Asset Donut** |
| **Compliance Engine** | SEC rule-based suitability | CSRC R1–R5 matching | Standard broker risk warnings | **Real-time Suitability Sentinel with Audit Proof** |
| **Explainability** | Static text blurbs | Conversational Q&A | Community sentiment & news | **Deterministic Quant-to-Text Explainability (XAI)** |

### The Competitive Gap We Exploit
* **Traditional Robo-Advisors** lack conversational intelligence, nuance, and empathy; users feel isolated filling out dry questionnaires.
* **Pure LLM Chatbots** lack visual feedback; text walls cannot intuitively convey portfolio covariance, risk cones, or diversification benefits.
* **WeAdvisory AI bridges the gap**: The user converses with an empathetic agent on the left, while the right side of the screen **dynamically updates charts, risk metrics, and compliance badges in real time** with zero lag.

---

# Design System & Visual Tokens

The aesthetic targets a **state-of-the-art fintech dark theme**: calming, high-contrast, premium, and trustworthy.

## Color Palette Tokens

```
Background Primary   : #0B0F17 (Deep Obsidian Slate)
Background Surface   : #131B2A (Translucent Glass Navy, backdrop-blur 16px)
Border Token         : rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)
Text Primary         : #F8FAFC (Crisp Platinum)
Text Muted           : #94A3B8 (Cool Slate)
Accent Cyan / Blue   : #00D2FF / #3A86FF (WeBank Tech Glow)
Accent Emerald (Safe): #10B981 (Compliant / Profit / Low Risk)
Accent Amber (Warn)  : #F59E0B (Moderate Risk / Suitability Advisory)
Accent Rose (Veto)   : #F43F5E (Regulatory Hard-Stop / Boundary Breach)
```

## Typography & Micro-Animations
* **Primary Font**: `Inter` or `Geist Sans` for structural clarity and numerical legibility.
* **Monospace Font**: `JetBrains Mono` for audit IDs, transaction hashes, and risk weights.
* **React Bits Integration**:
  1. *Subtle Dither / Ambient Background*: Soft radial gradient accentuating the active cockpit panel.
  2. *Animated Number Counter (`NumberTicker`)*: Smooth value transitions when rebalancing capital ($50,000 $\to$ $53,420).
  3. *Glassmorphism Card Wrappers*: Clean bordered containers with subtle reflection on hover.

# Functional Component Hierarchy

The front-end will be assembled from modular, decoupled React components:

```
src/
├── components/
│   ├── layout/
│   │   ├── TopNavbar.tsx           # Global status bar, tier pill, audit modal trigger
│   │   └── SplitScreenLayout.tsx   # Responsive grid container (50/50 desktop)
│   ├── chat/
│   │   ├── AdvisorChatPanel.tsx    # Scrollable dialogue feed with streaming support
│   │   ├── MessageBubble.tsx       # Message card with role styling (user, assistant, sentinel)
│   │   ├── QuickActionChips.tsx    # Context-sensitive suggestions ("Simulate shock", "Why this?")
│   │   └── ChatInputBar.tsx        # Message field with voice/text input and submit button
│   ├── cockpit/
│   │   ├── SuitabilityBadgeCard.tsx# Live CSRC R1-R5 indicator with ceiling gauges
│   │   ├── AllocationDonut.tsx     # Recharts/Chart.js animated donut with hover breakdown
│   │   ├── MonteCarloChart.tsx     # Interactive area chart showing P10, P50, P90 trajectories
│   │   └── AuditTrailDrawer.tsx    # Slide-over modal displaying SHA-256 audit log
│   └── ui/                         # Base Shadcn UI primitives (Button, Card, Tooltip, Badge)
```

---

# User Journey & State Transitions

The end-to-end user session progresses through 4 clear, measurable states:

```
[ STATE 0: ONBOARDING ]
User arrives -> Welcomed by Lead Orchestrator -> Initiates psychometric dialogue.
      |
      v
[ STATE 1: PROFILING & DIAGNOSTIC ]
Profiler Agent extracts investment horizon, risk threshold, and cash-flow needs.
Result: Formally assigned CSRC Tier (e.g. R3) displayed on the Cockpit.
      |
      v
[ STATE 2: OPTIMIZATION & EXPLAINABILITY ]
Deterministic Quant Engine runs Markowitz / Max Sharpe optimization.
Cockpit animates: Allocation Donut renders; Monte Carlo cone projects growth;
Advisor explains rationale in natural language.
      |
      v
[ STATE 3: COMPLIANCE CHECK & EXECUTION ]
Compliance Sentinel audits allocation against R1-R5 rules (Pass / Block).
User reviews audit hash -> Clicks 'Execute Sandbox Order' -> Sandbox log created.
```

---

# Verification Checklist for UI/UX Phase

- [ ] Zero clutter: Every chart element must have a clear informative purpose.
- [ ] Instant visual reaction: Cockpit updates within < 300ms upon agent state change.
- [ ] Accessibility: High color contrast ratio (WCAG AA compliant) in dark mode.
- [ ] Responsive behavior: Graceful adaptation from 1920x1080 desktop to 1366x768 laptops.
